# Free trial

Start on the Starter plan with your first 31 days free and $5 in usage credits.

## Introduction

New Starter subscriptions get their **first 31 days free**. Laravel Cloud waives the \$5 monthly fee, and you receive **\$5 in usage credits**. Use them to ship your first application on Laravel Cloud, on us.

## Getting started

Sign up at [cloud.laravel.com](https://laravel.com/sign-up), select the Starter plan, and add your payment details. Laravel Cloud applies your first 31 days free and \$5 in usage credits automatically.


Your resources consume credits as you provision and run them. How far they go depends on what you deploy and for how long.

> [!TIP]
>
> Because [scale to zero](https://laravel.com/cloud/docs/compute#scale-to-zero) is on by default, your compute and resources stop consuming credits while your application is idle, so your trial lasts longer.

## How far does \$5 go?

Laravel Cloud compute and many resources can [scale to zero](https://laravel.com/cloud/docs/compute#scale-to-zero) when your application is idle. While scaled to zero, they stop consuming credits until traffic returns. For many users, scaling to zero makes the \$5 go surprisingly far.

Here are a few realistic examples:

| Scenario | What is running | Estimated runtime |
| - | - | - |
| Weekend tinkerer | Compute + Serverless Postgres, awake about 1 hour per day | About 4 months |
| Active side project | Compute + Serverless Postgres, awake about 4 hours per day | About 5 weeks |
| Full-stack app with cache | Compute + Serverless Postgres + Valkey | About 3 weeks |
| Everything always on | Compute, Serverless Postgres, Valkey, and WebSockets active and always on | About 7 days |

These are estimates, not guarantees. Actual usage depends on the resources you provision, how long they stay active, and whether scale to zero is enabled.

## After your first 31 days

If your usage stays under \$5 during your first 31 days, you pay nothing. During this period, Laravel Cloud charges you only for usage above your \$5 in credits. After your first 31 days, standard Starter billing begins at \$5 per month plus any usage beyond your monthly \$5 in credits. Your app stays online, and nothing turns off.

[View plans and pricing](https://laravel.com/cloud/docs/pricing)
